title: Man, 92, to go on trial for historic Bristol rape and murder case - BBC News
text: Man, 92, to go on trial for 1967 rape and murder case Ryland Headley appeared via video link at Bristol Magistrates' Court on Wednesday A 92-year-old man will go on trial next year after being charged with the rape and murder of an elderly woman 57 years ago.

title: Newham: Residents warned after gas bottle explodes in bin lorry - BBC News
text: An east London council is urging residents to dispose of hazardous waste properly after an empty gas bottle thrown in a household bin exploded in a refuse lorry, injuring a worker.
